# Leadership Team

Pioneers of the Internet era with a proven track record of turning ideas into reality.

Our family of over 1,000 DataBankers is nurtured and inspired every day by a leadership team drawn from all walks of life. But one thing we share in common is a passion for managing the IT infrastructure that touches every part of our lives. We are pioneers of the Internet era, who’ve helped evolve its underlying infrastructure over 30 years and successfully led organizations through every phase – from the dot-com boom, to the cloud era, to the age of artificial intelligence. We know where IT infrastructure has come from. We see where it’s going next. And we believe the most exciting evolution is yet to come.

Joe Minarik

Chief Operating Officer

Joe Minarik joined DataBank as Chief Operations Officer in January 2022 and is responsible for all data center and colocation operations, engineering, construction, managed services, network and security, and IT operations. Minarik is a pioneer in the cloud and data center community, having joined Amazon in 2005, a year before the public launch of AWS. In his 16 years there, Minarik led the development of the company’s underlying data center and network infrastructure.
